# linearctl milestone

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill-docs.py from --help; do not edit. -->

## linearctl milestone list

```
List project milestones, the names issue create and update take for --milestone.
progress is Linear's, from 0 to 1.

Fields: id, name, targetDate, progress, project

Usage:
  linearctl milestone list [flags]

Examples:
  linearctl milestone list --project "Q4 launch" --json

Flags:
      --cursor CURSOR   continue after CURSOR (nextCursor from the previous page)
      --fields FIELDS   return only these comma-separated FIELDS (see Fields above)
  -h, --help            help for list
      --limit N         show at most N items; 0 for all (default 50)
      --project NAME    only milestones of project NAME
```
